items.title: [负面] Game continuously put out patch after another that...
items.summary:
Game continuously put out patch after another that is player-antagonistic and frequently, they go back on their words. This has reached a fever pitch with the new D-Tide change, which is the most braindead change I've seen. They literally just multiplied the numbers to the mobs without considering existing mechanics of the game which made most of the premium units obsolete in higher difficulties as well as pretty much every single team comp/strat, while not adding any new gameplay mechanisms to make it different from previous version.  In addition, it became mandatory to purchase the premium tier "monthly" pass, as the endgame content has become turn resetting over and over again and praying for RNG, sucking the life out of the content as it became an extremely tedious time sink.

This is especially harmful to new players as the game previous encouraged well thought out horizontal team building and strategy, but over night it became a heavy vertical investment game. This killed one of the biggest strength of the game, as Morimens used to be a game that allowed to make team and units that you like work as long as you put thought, effort and investment into it, but now it has become just like any other predatory gacha out there that forces you to be a "meta slave" robbing player choice and agency. On top of that, they also changed the shop more expensive and less accessible to newer players who lack the resources. This is on top of all the creeping patches after patches that steered the game to more P2W direction.

Best part is they were selling units that would have been top tier in the previous version of the game, while knowing that they will become obsolete once they made these changes leading up to the patch day. Yet the only thing they provided for this huge transition was non-premium unit reset tokens. Following the obvious backlash, they continued to make excuses to justify themselves by using niche case examples and with a half-assed "apology" gave 100 temporary pulls. Keep in mind that this game is an extremely dupe heavy game that requires 16 dupess to fully max a unit, 8 dupes to unlock stronger version of the ultimate, and 4 dupes just to unlock abilities that makes the unit whole. With 30 pull 50/50 half ceiling and hard ceiling at 3 SSR pull, you literally get 1 guaranteed dupe with 90 pulls. Yet they made many units, including ones they were selling literally weeks leading upto the patch, obsolete while spitting in players faces by only providing non-premium unit resets when these have even less value now since non-premium units cannot even be considered with very few exceptions in the current version, when the previous version allowed you to make most of them work in endgame contents.

I can no longer promote this game in good conscience seeing the user-antagonistic direction the devs have been taking since the last anni. Shame to see the horrendous state this game is in now compared to just months ago in 3 year anniv.

items.title: [负面] Overall, the game is very good, but the recent cha...
items.summary:
Overall, the game is very good, but the recent changes are sucking the fun out of it. We suddenly have extreme difficulty spikes that aren't clearable not only without the newest characters, but without their high-copy features. They rolled out a massive P2W feature after promising they would drip-feed it to us slowly, they lied multiple times about the future plans, namely the state of the character roster, saying the plan was set for the whole year and couldn't possibly be edited anymore, then suddenly dropped a three-month long dead patch, after which they admited they made major changes to the roadmap that ended up pushing everything back as well as that they apparently didn't have enough in the roadmap to fill the full year anyway? Add on top of that the fact that they will no longer release regular realms (elemental effects) and stick only to divine versions of said realms, that are generally seen as way inferior and underpowered, thus even further nerfing older characters that weren't built with these variations in mind. That is not even mentioning replacing rewards in events and stories with EXPIRING currency.

If you're looking to start a new gacha, run from this one. It is genuinely not worth it at this point.
